beforeDevCommand.script: cargo build -p teryon && node ../desktop/scripts/copy-teryon.mjs debug && bun run start

beforeBuildCommand.script: bun run build && cargo build --release -p teryon && node ../desktop/scripts/copy-teryon.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Run coding agents on your projects
bundle.longDescription: Teryon runs coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Grok on your projects, each on its own copy of the code, and keeps them working after the window closes.
